source: Eight ADSP-2181s on the eicon420 Diva 4BRI-8 PCI v2, SN 12196, adapter 5, booted by tools/eicon_dsp_bench.py's MIPS stub. Runs of 2026-10-22; every DSP in a run returned identical results for the suite it ran.  loops and stacks are from the run of 2026-10-23, the four seqprobe suites from the run of 2026-10-23 that followed the TOPPC work. The irqclean, timerphase, timerphase2 and timerirq suites are from the 2026-10-22 follow-up, confirmed with two copies per suite on all eight DSPs, after a quiet post-boot interval before IDMA polling. The astat_write, mstat_write, idle_timer and flags_only suites were confirmed in a second 2026-10-22 follow-up, with two identical copies per suite in the final eight-DSP run. SPORT register conversion suites are from the 2026-10-22 SPORT follow-up: native transmit ranges were repeated on all eight DSP jobs; receive-code and timing suites were repeated with identical copies. Serial clock/frame/autobuffer behavior is not asserted by these internal-companding results.
